text_block_list.text:
"They're sold out of
Windy-chan's rock-hard kelp stripsss~!!"

text_block_list.name: School Store Lady
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry.
We're actually fresh out right now...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Gugugu... I want that satisfying chewwwinessss!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Unable to buy her beloved snacks,
Shinko Windy was left feeling down in the dumps."
